title: Liamducks Epic TeamPlugin
description: Adds a simple team system for survival servers with commands to create teams, invite players, use team chat, set homes, and manage team info.
body:
This Plugin adds 
A team system for any type of survival server!
Heres the commands!

/team create <name>
/team invite <player>
/team leave
/team disband
/team sethome
/team home
/team chat
/team info

I really hope you enjoy using this plugin!!
